Nov. 10th Joseph Pfaff - 65 - Liver cancer - heart and stomach. Melvina Hoover - St. Joseph Retreat - 30 - mental. .

Nov. 12th Mrs. Popelier - Cancer of W.
12th V. Cecelia Nelson - 12 - corea and rhumatic fever in Ann Arbor Hosp. Anointed as hopeless last Thursday, hemoraging. Father a Lutheran Enrolls her To-night at 7:40 p.m. - urged to promise something of a sacrifice if Child be spared.
15th
Eliz. Penn - 23 months - lukemia - Drs. give no hope .... Surprising improvement since last Wed. 15th Deo Gr.
20th
27th Mother gives transfusion. . . Hopes .... Mother had been away from confession for 4 yrs.
15 Beverley Smith - 3 - bright child otherwise but unable to talk or walk properly - seems scared.
Mary McPhail - 34 - internal tuomer - fears 2nd operation Richard DeCaire - 4 - of Escanaba - loss of eye seriously threa- tened.
Eliz. Summers - 43 - lost breast 12 yrs. ago - now seems full of it. Drs. give her possibly 3 months
15 Patricia Simon - 6 - diptheria
Pauline Fontes - 35 - no church - worries about sick husband .... wants to be religious .... husband ought to be c ......
Page 168 Nov. 15th Roy LaValley - 19 - one eye gone - the other hemoraging - Mother dead was not Cath. Boy never baptized - Father ought to be Cath .... Enrolled To-day 50c
Ivy Lewis - 46 - of New Baltimore - nerveous breakdown Beverly Ann Louis - 3 - adnoids
Donie Koltz - 7 mo. - water on brain - head 24 inches . ...
